title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
evidence: GET https://staging.acme-demo.com/ -> response missing Content-Security-Policy header
remediation: Define and deploy a strict Content-Security-Policy header appropriate for the application.

title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
evidence: GET https://staging.acme-demo.com/ -> response missing Strict-Transport-Security header
remediation: Add HSTS with a long max-age, includeSubDomains, and preload after validation.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
evidence: GET https://staging.acme-demo.com/ -> response missing X-Frame-Options header
remediation: Set X-Frame-Options to DENY or SAMEORIGIN, or use CSP frame-ancestors.

title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS
evidence: GET http://dev.acme-demo.com/ -> 200 OK over plaintext HTTP; no redirect to HTTPS observed
remediation: Redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS and enforce HSTS on the HTTPS endpoint.

title: Server version disclosure
remediation: Configure the web server to suppress detailed version information in response headers.

title: Server version disclosure
remediation: Configure the web server to suppress detailed version information in response headers.

title: TLS certificate expiring soon
evidence: TLS certificate for staging.acme-demo.com expires in 21 days (2026-05-31T23:59:59Z)
remediation: Renew the TLS certificate before expiry and automate renewal with ACME or managed certificates.

title: Non-production host publicly reachable
evidence: staging.acme-demo.com resolves to public IP 203.0.113.30 and responds over HTTPS
remediation: Restrict staging access to trusted networks, VPN, or identity-aware proxy controls.

title: Non-production host publicly reachable
evidence: dev.acme-demo.com resolves to public IP 203.0.113.40 and responds over HTTP
remediation: Restrict development environment access to trusted networks or VPN and require authentication.

title: Missing Permissions-Policy header
evidence: GET https://www.acme-demo.com/ -> response missing Permissions-Policy header
remediation: Add a Permissions-Policy header to disable unused browser features.

title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security header
evidence: GET https://mail.acme-demo.com/ -> response missing Strict-Transport-Security header
remediation: Add HSTS to reduce downgrade risk for HTTPS services.

title: Command Injection in lodash
evidence: package-lock.json reports lodash@4.17.15; advisory GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm affects versions < 4.17.21

title: Prototype Pollution in minimist
evidence: package-lock.json reports minimist@1.2.5; advisory GHSA-xvch-5gv4-984h affects versions < 1.2.6
remediation: Upgrade minimist to 1.2.6 or later and verify transitive dependency resolution.

title: node-fetch forwards secure headers to untrusted sites
evidence: package-lock.json reports node-fetch@2.6.6; advisory GHSA-r683-j2x4-v87g affects versions < 2.6.7
